# Heroes

> Heroes is a small compiled programming language designed so that every
> plausible LLM mistake is a compile error. Made for LLMs, yet plain to human
> eyes: no null, no exceptions, no implicit conversions, no standard library —
> everything comes from C through an FFI that clang verifies against the real
> headers. The compiler is written in Heroes and reproduces itself byte for
> byte (the fixpoint holds, three generations deep, one SHA-256).

The entire language specification is deliberately small — measured at 3512
tokens against a hard ceiling of 4096 — because the spec is not documentation,
it is the prompt. If you are a language model asked to write Heroes, read the
spec first; it is the whole language:

- [The specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/giuseppearici/heroes-lang/main/spec/heroes-spec.md): the whole language in ~3512 tokens, written to be your prompt

Ground rules a generated program must respect: exactly one way to write
anything (a canonical formatter; 4-space indentation, tabs are errors); named
arguments are mandatory where two parameters share a type; `match` is
exhaustive and `_` is forbidden on variants; failure is a value (`T?`,
`ok`/`fail`/`?`) — there is no null and there are no exceptions; `???` is a
legal expression that reports what belongs in the gap instead of failing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://heroes-lang.org/index.html): what the language is, one real sample, the claim
- [Why Heroes](https://heroes-lang.org/why.html): the founding constraint (no standard library), the thesis, the cost formula, the objections answered
- [Errors](https://heroes-lang.org/errors.html): diagnostics as a deliverable — real output with machine-applicable fixes tagged `certain`, and the measured catch rate (96% vs a 79% control on 529 injected mistakes)
- [Self-hosted](https://heroes-lang.org/selfhost.html): the fixpoint — 143 modules and 34,812 lines of Heroes emitting byte-identical C across three compiler generations
- [The Zen](https://heroes-lang.org/zen.html): twenty lines the binary prints from `heroes this`
- [Build log](https://heroes-lang.org/log.html): one postcard per milestone, newest first
- [Documentation](https://heroes-lang.org/docs/index.html): the language page by page; every code block is a slice of a repository file that compiles and runs

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/giuseppearici/heroes-lang): the compiler, the spec, the design record — build with `cargo build`, then `./target/debug/heroes run examples/gallery/00-first.hero`
- [Examples](https://github.com/giuseppearici/heroes-lang/tree/main/examples/gallery): twelve small programs, one per language idea; every code block on the site is anchored to one of these files

## Notes

- Status: pre-release, built in the open. The fixpoint is measured; the Rust
  bootstrap is not yet archived; there is no installer yet.
- Diagnostics are machine-readable: `heroes check --json` emits schema 1 with
  stable snake_case codes, spans, notes and fixes.
